probe: 3 coordinates at mid-length upper corner; reset interaction
target: all 243 coordinates under oblique held interaction
fixed: minimum prior expected posterior target variance; frozen before noisy observations
adaptive: minimum expected posterior target variance given prefix
random: exact mean over both reset actions
truth: Two original objects, fine n8 FEM
forward: Nine n4 FEM hypotheses; separate from PhysTwin
scope: Finite-prior controlled reference only; not a learned posterior or population calibration
